data.title: 'What Remains' runs until Sunday at Central Embassy
data.description: Art lovers have until Sunday to discover the echoes of feelings and experiences through "What Remains", which is running on the ground floor of Central Embassy, Phloenchit Road.

data.title: Manga madness at The Mall Bangkae
data.description: Enter the immersive world of Japanese culture during "The Mall Lifestore Manga Multiverse", at M Grand Hall and M Fashion Hall 1, ground floor of The Mall Lifestore Bangkae, Phetkasem Road, from today until next Wednesday.

data.title: Campaign to support political prisoners opens submissions for typographic poster art
data.description: The Weight Of Sentences civic campaign organised by 112Watch and the Thai Lawyers for Human Rights has opened submissions for typographic poster art to support political prisoners or those living in exile.

data.title: DSI head appointment raises PP ire
data.description: The opposition has raised concerns over the appointment of Pol Capt Piya Raksakul as the new director-general of the Department of Special Investigation (DSI), warning the agency could be turned into a political tool or used to benefit people facing criminal charges.

data.title: Traffy Fondue to expand its reach across govt agencies
data.description: The Traffy Fondue platform has been adopted as a central government service for reporting and managing urban problems, the Minister of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation, Yodchanan Wongsawat, said.

data.title: PP 'has no shield' for probe MPs
data.description: The People's Party (PP) will not shield MPs Pawoot Pongvitayapanu or Somchart Techathavorncharoen with parliamentary immunity if evidence links them to wrongdoing, said the party leader.

data.title: House passes bill to protect debtors
data.description: The House of Representatives has passed a bill amending the Bankruptcy Act to protect honest debtors undergoing court-approved debt rehabilitation.

data.title: Sondhi asks public to turn out for EC complaint
data.description: Protest leader Sondhi Limthongkul and allies are urging the public to join them in filing a complaint with the Election Commission (EC) tomorrow over Senate election collusion.

data.title: Peerawat steps in for injured Jonathan
data.description: Thailand head coach Anthony Hudson has called up Port defender Peerawat Akkrathum as a replacement for Jonathan Khemdee, who has been ruled out of the Fifa Asean Cup 2026 after sustaining a serious knee injury in training.

data.title: Club fined after pitch roller mishap
data.description: Pattani FC have been fined 50,000 baht by the Football Association of Thailand (FAT) following an incident in which PT Prachuap FC winger Andros Townsend was struck and run over by a pitch roller during the half-time of a Thai League match.

data.title: Deals in future tech coveted
data.description: Thailand is seeking US investment partnerships focused on future technologies and sustainability, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said.

data.title: Turmoil 'may benefit' Asean
data.description: Asean sees an opportunity in global turmoil as investment and supply chains shift, policy experts told the Southeast Asia Trade and Development Forum 2026 held in Bangkok on Wednesday.

data.title: Govt firm on EU FTA talks
data.description: Thailand will not commit to the plant-variety protection treaty during next week's Thai-European Union (EU) free trade agreement (FTA) talks in Phuket, as more time is needed for consideration, the government says.

data.title: Israeli-linked Pattani land deal faces probe
data.description: The Interior Ministry will investigate an Israeli-linked company over a land purchase worth nearly 100 million baht in Pattani, checking funding sources and business purposes.

data.title: Thai students exempt from new visa measures
data.description: Australian authorities have reaffirmed that Thai students will be exempt from new visa measures affecting international students, while seeking closer cooperation with Thailand on trade, migration and regional security.

data.title: Thamanat watch fuels govt ties talk
data.description: Speculation over the Klatham Party's political ties with the government has intensified after its leader, Capt Thamanat Prompow, was seen wearing a Casio watch similar to one worn by Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.

data.title: At UN, OpenAI's Altman calls 'for extreme care' in AI
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - The current moment in AI development "calls for extreme care," OpenAI CEO Sam Altman told the UN Security Council on Wednesday, noting that the technology's advancement could accelerate rapidly.

data.title: US judge weighing Trump's White House ban on media outlets
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - A US federal judge was holding a hearing on Wednesday to consider a demand by CNN, MS NOW and Politico to have their White House access restored after their credentials were revoked by President Donald Trump.

data.title: Zelensky says Putin using fighters from 47 countries in Ukraine war
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky accused his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin of using third-country fighters from 47 countries to prosecute Moscow's war against Ukraine.

data.title: Ditch ‘enemy state’ label, Japanese PM tells UN
data.description: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has called on the United Nations to scrap references to former Axis powers as “enemy states” in its Charter — a World War II-era designation that China and Russia have recently used to attack Tokyo.

data.title: Golan will remain Syrian, president vows at UN
data.description: UNITED NATIONS - Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa insisted at the United Nations on Wednesday that the Golan Heights region will remain Syrian after Colombia last month recognised Israeli sovereignty over the strategically important territory.

data.title: Rights groups press Malaysia to stop Rohingya returns
data.description: ​More than ⁠160 ⁠civil society organisations released a ​joint statement on Wednesday urging Malaysia to halt plans to deport ​Rohingya refugees to Myanmar, citing ‌severe risks of ongoing violence and forced conscription.

data.title: Miss Universe Cambodia team admits error with Thai photos
data.description: The organisers of the Miss Universe Cambodia pageant have acknowledged their use of Thai historical photographs, saying the mistake was unintentional and resulted from “insufficient verification” of the original sources.

data.title: They came, they rode, they conquered
data.description: Thailand ended a 28-year wait for an Asian Games equestrian eventing team title on Wednesday, and backed it up with a clutch of further medals in skeet shooting, badminton, weightlifting and karate at Aichi-Nagoya 2026.

data.title: Russia probes bear attacks in region under ‘siege’
data.description: MOSCOW - At least six people have been killed in bear attacks in Russia’s vast Siberian region of Krasnoyarsk in a month, prosecutors said on Wednesday, as an official in a neighbouring region reported bears had put one town “under siege”.

data.title: Court rejects Yingluck’s appeal for rice-graft retrial
data.description: The Supreme Administrative Court has rejected an appeal by former prime minister Yingluck Shinawatra to retry the case that resulted in an order for her to pay 10 billion baht for losses from a rice-pledging scheme she oversaw more than a decade ago.

data.title: Ashlee Nino revealed as Nene’s drummer in AGT 2026 final
data.description: AGT house drummer Ashlee Nino praises Thai guitarist Nene Royal’s final after fans confuse her with The Warning’s Paulina Villarreal.

data.title: Nene Royal awaits AGT’s US$1m finale result on September 24
data.description: Thai singer Nene Royal performs ‘Seven Nation Army’ in the AGT final as Linkin Park join the guest line-up for the results show.
